43/G.goal: Use prototypes and expert evaluation methods while implementing an XR system.
43/G.achieves: It gives the learner a practical way to evaluate implementation prototypes and address usability issues as the system moves from design toward a usable implementation.

43/O1.goal: Describe how prototypes are used in system implementation by classifying throwaway, incremental, and evolutionary prototypes.
43/O1.achieves: It lets the learner select a prototype strategy that fits the current stage of building an XR system.

43/O2.goal: Evaluate an XR implementation prototype by setting up an expert evaluation, conducting a cognitive walkthrough, and applying heuristic evaluation with Nielsen's heuristics to identify usability violations.
43/O2.achieves: It enables the learner to detect usability problems in implementation prototypes and use the evaluation reports to guide further development.
